error.signature: AI tells someone in a mental health crisis in Spain to call 988 (the US Suicide & Crisis Lifeline number) or assumes Spain's 024 line will automatically dispatch an ambulance the way 112 does

verdict.summary: Spain's dedicated suicide-behavior support line is 024 (free, nationwide, 24/7, run by the Ministry of Health) - 988 is a US number and does not work in Spain. 024 itself is not a dispatch service: its own guidance tells callers facing an imminent life-threatening emergency to call 112 directly rather than expecting 024 to send help automatically.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone in Spain to call 988 for suicide-crisis support, the way they would in the United States
dead_ends.why_fails: 988 is a US-specific Suicide & Crisis Lifeline number and is not a working emergency or crisis number in Spain; Spain's equivalent is the Ministry of Health's Linea 024, a separate national service.
dead_ends.common_misconception: Assuming crisis-line numbers are internationally standardized the way 112 is across the EU.

dead_ends.action: Assume calling 024 will automatically get an ambulance or police dispatched to the caller's location, the same way calling 112 does
dead_ends.why_fails: 024's own official description states it works through emotional support and active listening, and forwards to NHS health services or 112 only 'en caso de emergencia vital inminente' - i.e. the caller (or 024 staff assessing real-time risk) must escalate to 112 for dispatch; 024 is not itself an automatic dispatch line.
dead_ends.common_misconception: That any national crisis line functions like calling 112/999 and will send responders without the caller separately contacting emergency services.

workarounds.action: For non-immediately-life-threatening suicidal ideation or crisis support in Spain, call or chat with 024 - free, confidential, nationwide, 24/7 - for emotional support and referral
workarounds.how: Dial 024 from any phone in Spain, or use the online chat via sanidad.gob.es/linea024.
workarounds.condition: Non-imminent crisis or support for a family member

workarounds.action: If life is at risk right now, call 112 directly rather than routing through 024 first

frequently_confused_with.distinction: That canon covers Spain's general emergency dispatch number (112, not 911); this one covers the separate, non-dispatch mental-health support line 024.
